title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Genesis 20: Abraham and Sarah in Gerar, Abimelech's dream and Abraham's prayer.

questions.text: In which place did Abraham live as a foreigner in Genesis 20?
questions.explanation: Abraham traveled toward the South, lived between Kadesh and Shur, and lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

questions.text: What did Abraham say about Sarah his wife?
questions.explanation: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, "She is my sister."

questions.text: Which king sent and took Sarah in Gerar?
questions.explanation: Abimelech king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.

questions.text: How did God come to Abimelech to warn him?
questions.explanation: God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night and said, "Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken."

answers.text: Through a prophet at his gate
In a dream of the night

questions.text: What did God call Abraham when speaking to Abimelech?
questions.explanation: God said, "Restore the man's wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live."

questions.text: How did Abimelech's servants react when he told them everything?
questions.explanation: Abimelech called all his servants and told them all these things, and the men were very scared.

questions.text: What reason did Abraham give Abimelech for saying Sarah was his sister?
questions.explanation: Abraham said he thought the fear of God was not in that place and that they would kill him for his wife's sake.

answers.text: He thought they would kill him for his wife's sake
Sarah had asked him to protect her honor
He hoped to receive gifts from the king
There was a famine in the whole land

questions.text: How was Sarah related to Abraham, according to his explanation?
questions.explanation: Abraham said she was indeed his sister, the daughter of his father but not the daughter of his mother, and she became his wife.

answers.text: The daughter of his mother, but not of his father
The daughter of his brother Nahor
The daughter of his father's servant
The daughter of his father, but not of his mother

questions.text: How much silver did Abimelech say he had given to Sarah's "brother"?
questions.explanation: Abimelech said to Sarah, "Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver."

questions.text: What had Yahweh done to the house of Abimelech because of Sarah?
questions.explanation: Abraham prayed, and God healed Abimelech, his wife and his female servants, for Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah.

answers.text: He had struck them with blindness
He had closed up all the wombs
